items.title: Beam Therapeutics sues base editing rival, claims former scientist stole secrets
items.description: Base editing biotech Beam Therapeutics is suing one of its newest rivals, alleging that the upstart company stole the secrets behind one of its lead programs and used them to craft a competing therapy.

items.description: Merck & Co. touted a win for its anti-TL1A antibody in a phase 2b trial in patients with moderate to severe hidradenitis suppurativa (HS).

items.title: Connect’s Dupixent rival reduces COPD attacks by 85%, but misses a secondary goal
items.description: Connect Biopharma has pointed to phase 2 data for its IL-4/IL-13 blocker as proof that the wannabe Dupixent rival can reduce respiratory attacks—although the study missed a secondary endpoint tied to a breathing test.

items.title: VertigoDx on firm ground with FDA greenlight for vertigo diagnostic system
items.description: The FDA  has granted 510(k) clearance to Miami-based VertigoDx for its portable diagnostic system that can evaluate vertigo, including benign paroxysmal positional vertigo (BPVV).

items.title: Roche, Zealand see phase 2 amylin weight loss peak at mid-dose, start pivotal program
items.description: Zealand Pharma has shared primary endpoint data on Roche-partnered petrelintide, revealing that the middle dose of the amylin analog delivered the highest weight loss—9.8%—at Week 28.
